title: r1 blocking QE: same-kind unanimity creates a gate-unpassable class and a flaky-at-HEAD delta escape
description: Evidence: gate-data.md:18 vs contract Phase exit by gate (line 64). Over-block: a genuine kind-unstable defect pin (race: panic/timeout/abort across runs) fails every run yet aggregates flaky, and every rescue lane's own predicate disqualifies it — an honest author can produce neither a valid red nor a lawful surrogate. Under-block: the suite delta is two-valued ('no test failing at HEAD that passed at baseline'); a flaky-at-HEAD baseline-passing test satisfies neither half and escapes the regression check. Dispositions: declared expected-kind SET as valid red; or a validator-approved kind-unstable recorded state; and independently the delta must fail-closed on flaky-at-HEAD. Owner: solution-owner (amends ratified gate text). Validator: quality-engineer.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: OPERATOR RULING (2026-07-21, round-1 triage): declared kind-set + fail-closed delta. The finding issue declares a SET of expected failure kinds; valid red = fails every run with each observed kind a member of the declared set — wrong-reason detection stays a mechanical set-membership check, no new approval lane. Independently: a baseline-passing test that aggregates flaky at HEAD FAILS the delta (fail-closed). Rejected: a validator-approved kind-unstable recorded state (human judgment where a set declaration suffices). Amendment-class — rides the round-1 amendment window. Data-side: gate-data gains the kind-set field shape at the fix pass.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIX LANDED (commit e61f28e5, gate-data 0.2.0): pin_kind_declaration block — declared expected-kind set, set-membership red rule, fail-closed delta rule; flake_policy aggregation and scope reworded to the kind-set grain with flaky-at-HEAD failing the delta. Contract touch rides #698. Round 2 re-verifies (validator: quality-engineer).
